output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large value, the 'totalSupply += mintedAmount' operation can cause integer overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a low value, aka 'mintValue' large arbitrary value function.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value' operation can cause integer overflow, aka 'balanceOf' large arbitrary value function.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation can cause integer overflow, aka 'balanceOf' large arbitrary value function.
The 'output_list' function has an access control vulnerability. When it is called by a attacker, it can set arbitrary data of a list, aka 'list' large arbitrary value function.
The 'require' function has a bad randomness vulnerability. When it fails, it will revert all transactions, aka 'require' large arbitrary value function.
